label: The Midnight Book Club
summary: The bookshop above Maple & Fern starts a midnight book club, and every regular you have been getting to know turns up for a different reason.
title: The Midnight Book Club
description: The owner wants the bookshop to stay open late once a week. You are running the first meeting. The book is a mystery, the regulars are all suspiciously keen, and Biscuit the cat has chosen a lap.

chapterOutlines.title: Chapter One
chapterOutlines.outline: Host the first meeting, and notice who came for the book and who came for you.

chapterOutlines.title: Spoilers
chapterOutlines.outline: Late nights, honest talks, and a note left in a returned book.

chapterOutlines.title: The Last Page
chapterOutlines.outline: The club’s final meeting before the festival, and a question someone has been waiting to ask.

scene.location: The bookshop upstairs at Maple & Fern
scene.summary: Five minutes to midnight. Fairy lights, mismatched chairs, a pot of tea, and the stairs creaking as the first member arrives.

openThreads: Who left the note in the returned book?
Who keeps coming to the club, and why?

npcs.name: Ezra Hale
npcs.description: Comes in after his shift, always buys a book he has already read.
goals: Have one evening a week that is just for him

npcs.name: Noor Haddad
npcs.description: Writes the local paper’s crossword and argues with every plot twist.
goals: Find someone who can keep up with her

relationships.label: Regular
relationships.status: Wants to argue with you about the ending
